name: French Press
description: A clean, low-sediment French press: long steep, skim the crust, press gently.

steps.text: Bring {water} to a boil, plus extra for preheating.
Rinse the press with hot water to preheat it, then discard the water.
Add the grounds and place the press on the scale. Tare.
Pour all the water in quickly, wetting every ground.
Break the crust with a spoon and skim off the foam and floating grounds.
Insert the plunger just to the surface of the coffee. Don't press down.
Pour slowly through the screen and stop before the last bit of sludge.

source.name: Adapted from James Hoffmann's French press technique
